posts.text: While the company has done well after Nirma took over, it is to be seen how they manage the GPL part of the revenue. That remains more or less flat. So even if Non-GPL is growing at around 20% YoY, GPL flat growth drags the overall growth down to lower double digit growth. CDMO is still very small part of their overall revenue mix. Also, the agreement was with GPL for supply till 5 years after Nirma took over. What happens after that? And how will that impact the GPL part of the business is to be clarified.
